title: Visualising Solid Shapes
description: Class 7 IMO — Visualising solid shapes: nets of cubes, cuboids, cylinders and cones, isometric and oblique sketches, and front, side and top views of 3D objects.

topics.title: Nets of 3D Shapes
topics.concept: A net is a flat shape that folds up into a solid. The net of a cube is 6 squares; a cuboid is 6 rectangles; a cylinder is 2 circles and 1 rectangle; and a cone is 1 circle and 1 curved sector.

examples.problem: How many squares are in the net of a cube?
What does the net of a cylinder contain?

recap: Cube net = 6 squares; cuboid net = 6 rectangles.
Cylinder net = 2 circles + 1 rectangle; cone net = 1 circle + 1 sector.

quiz.q: How many faces does the net of a cuboid have?
A cone's net has a circle and a ___ ?
quiz.explanation: A cone's curved surface opens into a sector.

topics.title: Sketches & Solid Properties
topics.concept: An isometric sketch is drawn on a dotted grid keeping true lengths; an oblique sketch shows the front face true with the depth slanted. Recall: a cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.

examples.problem: How many edges does a cube have?
How many vertices does a cuboid have?

recap: Isometric: true lengths on a dotted grid; oblique: front true, depth slanted.

quiz.q: How many faces does a cube have?
How many vertices does a cube have?

topics.title: Views of 3D Objects
topics.concept: A solid object can be drawn from different views: the front view, the side view and the top view. For example, the top view of a standing cylinder is a circle, and the front view of a cube is a square.

examples.problem: What is the top view of a standing cylinder?
What is the front view of a cube?

recap: Objects have front, side and top views.
Top view of a cylinder = circle; front view of a cube = square.

quiz.q: What is the top view of a ball (sphere)?
quiz.explanation: From any direction a sphere looks like a circle.

quiz.q: What is the side view of a cube?
quiz.explanation: A cube's side view is a square.

questions.q: A net of a cube has how many squares?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 faces, so its net has 6 squares.

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are 3D shapes)?
questions.explanation: A square is a 2D shape; the others are 3D.

questions.q: The top view of a standing cylinder is a ___ ?
questions.explanation: Looking down on a cylinder shows a circle.

questions.q: A cube has how many edges?
A cuboid has how many faces?
A cube has how many vertices?
A cylinder's net has 2 circles and a ___ ?
questions.explanation: The curved surface opens into a rectangle.

questions.q: A cone has how many vertices?
The front view of a cube is a ___ ?
questions.explanation: A cube's front view is a square.

questions.q: The top view of a sphere is a ___ ?
questions.explanation: A sphere looks like a circle from any view.

questions.q: A dice net is made of 6 ___ ?
Looking straight down at a tin (cylinder), it appears as a ___ ?
questions.explanation: The top view of a cylinder is a circle.

questions.q: For a cube with F = 6, V = 8 and E = 12, what is F + V − E?
